title: Continue-As-New threshold correction and non-tautological policy evidence

acceptance_gates.description: Continue-As-New thresholds match the v1.2 Temporal execution contract (>8,000 history events, >24h recurring execution) and are asserted against literal values rather than the constants under test.
A Continue-As-New threshold at or above Temporal's history termination limit is rejected at construction, so an unreachable policy cannot be configured.
The insufficient evidence originally recorded for FND-TEMP-G3 is documented, and both regressions are demonstrated to fail against the previous values.

rollback: Revert the correction commit. The thresholds are read at import time and no persisted state encodes them, so there is no data or schema compatibility implication; reverting restores the previous unreachable threshold and is therefore not a safe resting state.
